! Cholesterol [Contracts]

Required fields are marked with an asterisk (*)

Introduction

Information:

This template allows you to record the requirements in QoF:

  • For CHD, PAD, STIA, and CKD – prescribe a statin (or an alternative if unsuitable or declined).
  • For CHD, PAD, and STIA only – LDL should be 2.0 mmol/L or lower (or non-HDL ≤ 2.6 mmol/L if LDL is not recorded).


Click here to see detailed description of the requirements for QOF for cholesterol

Where to Record Personalised Care Adjustments (PCAs)
Personalised Care Adjustments are located within the relevant sections of the template:

  • For individual care activities (e.g. maximum tolerated treatment for blood pressure), PCAs can be recorded directly alongside the relevant item.
  • To remove a patient from the entire disease register, use the PCA section at the bottom of the template.
  • Invitation exemptions (e.g. two or more invitations at least seven days apart) are also recorded in the bottom section.

Personalised Care Adjustments - for taking a statin (CHOL003)

Information:

Either prescribe a statin, or use one of the following groups of actions to remove the patient from the eligibility criteria:

General PCA (exception) needed annually

Record why a statin cannot be taken and prescribe alternative lipid lowering therapy

Warning:

And make sure you prescribe one of the following:

  • Bempedoic acid
  • Ezetimibe
  • Inclisiran
  • PCSK9 inhibitors

General PCA (exception) needed once ever

Personalised Care Adjustments - for hitting lipid targets (CHOL004)

Information:

Either intensify the treatment, or use one of the following groups of actions to remove the patient from the eligibility criteria:

Patient Invitations

Information:

Use this section to record any invitations sent to the patient — both as part of usual care and to support PCA where applicable (e.g. two or more invitations at least 7 days apart for informed dissent).

Warning:

For cholesterol targets (CHOL004) two invites have to be sent a week apart after the last cholesterol result.

! Stroke [Contracts]

Required fields are marked with an asterisk (*)

Introduction

Information:

This template supports recording the key QoF requirements for Stroke/TIA, including:

  • Blood pressure within target
  • Use of an antiplatelet or anticoagulant


Where local enhanced schemes exist for stroke/TIA these will be shown here.

See PCIT support materials about STIA QOF requirements here

Where to Record Personalised Care Adjustments (PCAs)
Personalised Care Adjustments are located within the relevant sections of the template:

  • For individual care activities (e.g. maximum tolerated treatment for blood pressure), PCAs can be recorded directly alongside the relevant item.
  • To remove a patient from the entire disease register, use the PCA section at the bottom of the template.
  • Invitation exemptions (e.g. two or more invitations at least seven days apart) are also recorded in the bottom section.

Blood Pressure Control (CD001, CD002)

Information:

Patients without frailty have the following BP targets:

  • under 80 have a target BP of 140/90 or less (or 135/85 if home or ambulatory blood pressure reading)
  • over 80 have a target of 150/90 or less (or 145/85 if home or ambulatory blood pressure reading).

    Frailty removes BP targets for patients.
